name: Bolwren
subtitle: English Speaking Practice
shortDescription: Speak English with confidence. Short lessons with Hindi help, listening, speaking practice and a plan that adapts to your mistakes.
longDescription:
Learn spoken English from Hindi with short daily lessons. Practise everyday talk, workplace English and interview answers. Hear every phrase, build sentences, and say them out loud: on-device speech recognition checks word by word and shows which words to fix.

### Learn with Hindi Help
Hindi explanations make rules clear. Fix typical mistakes with grammar lessons, sound lessons for V/W, TH and more, and a mistake notebook that brings wrong answers back with the reason.

### A Plan That Adapts
A spaced-repetition review keeps phrases fresh, and your daily plan picks the topics you need.

### Private
No account, works offline, your progress stays on your phone.

Free to use with 2 free lessons and short rewarded ads for more, or go ad-free with a monthly plan. Reviews are always free. Hindi text is machine drafted pending native review. Speaking feedback and readiness are approximations, not exam scores.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
